notes: Fork topology: issues live upstream (Sniper7Kills-LLC/claude-plugins). Integration branches and member draft PRs live on the fork (Crank-Git/claude-plugins, git remote `fork`). The batch PR goes from the fork into upstream dev. The batch PR merge: the PM asks the operator, and merges after a yes (GitHub does not let Crank-Git approve its own PR). A dogfood pass in a fresh headless session runs before every batch PR merges. Python is stdlib-only; each new script gets a scripts/test-*.py suite wired into .github/workflows/validate.yml. The evals live in the repo-level evals/, run by scripts/run-evals.py on headless claude -p. Paid eval runs go one at a time, under --max-cost-usd 150 per full worker comparison.
